qa.title: Q1147 (Apr. 4, 2025)
qa.question: My opponent has Ancient Protector on their field, and I have Spartacus. While resolving this follower's "at the start of your end phase" ability, I draw enough cards that my deck is down to a single card. Do I then win the game?
qa.answer: No, the game goes on. When one effect instructs a player to perform an action ("win the game") that is prohibited by another active effect ("you can't lose the game, and opponents can't win"), the prohibiting effect takes precedence.

qa.title: Q1146 (Apr. 4, 2025)
qa.question: If my deck is empty when playing this follower's "at the start of your end phase" ability, do I lose the game?
qa.answer: No, you win. After discarding any number of cards, you draw that many plus 1. Drawing cards from an empty deck means you will lose the game at the next confirmation timing. However, you finish resolving this ability first, and since there's 1 card or less in your deck, you win the game immediately.

qa.title: Q1145 (Apr. 4, 2025)
qa.question: Can I choose not to discard any cards when playing this follower's "at the start of your end phase" ability?
qa.answer: Yes. "Any number" includes 0. If you choose not to discard any cards, you draw one card.

qa.title: Q1156 (Apr. 4, 2025)
qa.question: I have 4 cards in my EX area. What happens when I play this follower's Fanfare ability?
qa.answer:
If you find 2 Earth Sigil amulets in your deck, pick one of them to put into your EX area, then shuffle your deck.

If you only find one, or choose to "only find one" even when there are more, put it into your EX area, then shuffle your deck.

You can also choose to not find any, in which case you simply shuffle your deck.

In any case, Earth Sigil amulets you put into your EX area this way cost 0 to play for the rest of the turn.

qa.title: Q1170 (Apr. 4, 2025)
qa.question: If I have multiple cards with an "At the start of your end phase" ability triggering, in what order do I resolve them?
qa.answer: You can resolve them in any order. When you proceed to your end phase, all "At the start of your end phase" abilities are triggered and become pending. Then, you can choose the order in which you resolve the pending abilities.

qa.title: Q1169 (Apr. 4, 2025)
qa.question: I have 2 copies of this follower on my field at the start of my end phase, and they both have 5 defense. How do I resolve their abilities?
qa.answer:
You must resolve the "at the start of your end phase" ability of both copies, and both of them end up in the cemetery.

First, at the start of your end phase, the corresponding abilities of both copies trigger and become pending. You then resolve them one by one.

The first copy's ability deals 5 damage to each other follower on the field, bringing the defense of the other copy to 0 and putting it into the cemetery.

Even though the second copy is now in the cemetery, you still resolve its pending ability, dealing 5 damage to each follower on the field, bringing the defense of the first copy to 0 and putting it into the cemetery as well.
